prompt:
Precise edit of this existing product packaging presentation. Preserve the overall composition, camera, warm ivory background, two packages, brand logos, blue/cream colors, printed textile texture, product title, weight, nutritional label layout on the back, and printed photo of kurt on front.
Make the following changes:
1. On the large FRONT-facing pouch, show it just opened for consumption: the top heat seal has been torn away and the two flexible film lips are gently spread apart creating a modest but clearly visible oval opening. Reveal 3-4 actual golden smoked kurt pieces INSIDE the bag through that opening. They must be clearly distinguishable as physical food inside, not printed on film. Plausible tear edge, slight inward view, realistic film thickness and soft interior shadows. Keep the front logo and title fully visible. The opened pouch has relaxed slightly since the vacuum has been released; do not depict an inflated balloon or change into a fabric sack. No real drawstring. The small back-view pouch on the right remains sealed.
2. Remove the exact word "ДОРБА" from the center of the front pouch below "Курт копчёный", and remove BOTH short horizontal blue lines flanking that word. Fill the cleared region seamlessly with the same ivory printed textile texture. Do not replace it with any new words or ornaments.
3. Also remove the large "ДОРБА" heading at top left of the presentation and its underline, leaving clean breathing room above the existing subtitle. Keep other left-side captions and their rules intact.
All other text, especially corrected ingredients and storage conditions on the right pouch, must remain unchanged. No new labels, arrows, explanatory text, hands or scissors. Refined highly photorealistic image.

Use case: product-mockup.
Create a photorealistic packaging design presentation for Gormolzavod Kokshetau smoked kurt, a Kazakh dairy snack, concept "ДОРБА". Landscape image, premium clean warm ivory studio background with soft grounded shadows, two views of the same package: large front three-quarter on left and smaller back three-quarter on right. One spare golden smoked kurt ball on the studio surface is fine, no other props.
The referenced image is solely the official brand logo. Reproduce the complete logo upright, unaltered proportions and colors, never replace its lettering or reshape it.
CRITICAL manufacturing realism: this is an ordinary commercially manufacturable rectangular flexible vacuum pouch with simple STRAIGHT heat-sealed top and bottom edges, visible flat seal margins about 10mm, and a tiny tear notch at top side. No custom die-cut shape, no handle, no stand-up gusset, no drawstring, no ribbon, no neck tie, no fabric exterior, no rigid box. Contains approximately ten irregular round solid kurt pieces nominal 12g each, total 120g. Film is visibly vacuum drawn tightly around clustered pieces with believable irregular bulges and creases, NOT a smooth inflated stand-up bag. Broad central printed region remains legible. Lean the pouch naturally slightly backward for the studio view, not magically standing like a cardboard box.
The traditional cloth sack appearance is ONLY PRINTED artwork on the plastic film. Print an ivory cotton-weave pattern subtly on the cream package, minimal gently illustrated blue gathered folds and a simple thin blue DRAWN cord bow below the flat top seal. The drawn string must look two-dimensional ink, not a real attached string. Make this distinction obvious. Slim geometric Kazakh ornament trim down one edge, with restrained blue mountain line details. Modern contemporary brand, clean everyday product not expensive gift packaging.
Color palette ivory #FCF8F3 35%, light blue #A4CFFF 30%, blue #0861C6, white and dark navy; tiny coral accent only in authentic logo. No brown kraft paper look, no green eco badges, no woodgrain. Matte-looking printed plastic with realistic subtle glossy highlights at strained folds, not cloth.
Front design: official logo at upper center surrounded by clean clear space. Product name in large readable bold Open Sans-like sans serif, Kazakh first: "ҚҰРТ ЫСТАЛҒАН"; Russian below "Курт копчёный". Smaller concept name "ДОРБА". An appetizing PRINTED photograph of three golden smoked kurt balls and a subtle blue wisp of smoke in lower middle to clearly show the product; keep image distinct from physical surface bulges. Weight at bottom "Таза салмағы / Масса нетто" and "120 г". At lower right a tidy white reserved square labeled "QR" with bilingual small CTA "Кодты тірке" then "Зарегистрируй код". This is a QR placement placeholder not a functional QR.
Back design visible on the right package: the same cream textile-print visual language with clean aligned structured bilingual information blocks, headings "Құрамы / Состав", "Сақтау / Хранение", "Өндіруші / Изготовитель", "Күні / Дата", "Партия". Render only enough small design typography to demonstrate label layout, no invented certification, no fake EAC, no specific ГОСТ numbers, no fabricated expiry guarantee. A reserved empty barcode field labeled "EAN" at bottom and clear blank date/lot fields. Do not print claims of plastic-free, biodegradability, no microplastics, or approved certification.
Board heading top left outside packages: "ДОРБА"; smaller subtitle "Традиционный образ · вакуумная упаковка". Below, generous white space with three short captions in dark blue: "Стандартный пакет" / "Завязка — рисунок" / "120 г". Tiny bottom footer "Концепция дизайна. Материал и срок хранения требуют проверки."
Professional realistic commercial food-packaging visualization, crisp beautiful typography, high detail. Main emphasis is achievable low-complexity vacuum pouch and printed traditional sack illusion. No arrows, no busy infographic, no fake production certification.

Edit this packaging presentation image with very precise localized text corrections ONLY on the back of the smaller right pouch. Preserve all other composition, packaging shapes, colors, photography, logo, front pouch, left titles, bottom disclaimer and QR placeholder. Under "Құрамы / Состав" replace the two ingredient lines exactly with "Майсыз сүзбе, ас тұзы." and "Творог нежирный, соль поваренная пищевая." Remove every reference to milk as the ingredient and to natural smoke as an ingredient. Under "Сақтау / Хранение" replace generic cool dry text with four small neat lines exactly: "+15 °C-тан жоғары емес." / "Ауа ылғалдылығы 75%-дан аспайды." / "Не выше +15 °C." / "Влажность воздуха не более 75%." Under "Өндіруші / Изготовитель" replace existing invented organization names with exactly "«Гормолзавод» ЖШС" and "ТОО «Гормолзавод»". Fit these accurate texts neatly, shift lower blocks slightly only if necessary. This is still a design concept with incomplete back label; do not add certification or claim compliance. No other changes.

Use case product-mockup. Create a photorealistic two-panel packaging presentation, landscape 1536x1024. Use attached reference 1 as EXACT front print artwork for a new standard rectangular vacuum pouch of smoked kurt 120g. Preserve the authentic logo and exact title, weight, blue/ivory colors, bow illustration, thin ornamental side borders, product photograph and reserved white QR square from reference 1. Reference 2 shows the desired realistic flexible plastic vacuum package material and traditional textile-print illusion, not the text layout. No "ДОРБА" word anywhere. The product is a food-grade plastic pouch, NOT fabric, no real string. Straight heat seal, no zip, no handle. 
Left half: one CLOSED sealed filled pouch in attractive three-quarter studio view on neutral ivory surface. Realistic subtle wrinkles around ten solid round kurt pieces, straight rectangular margins; logo and label readable. Right half: several identical CLOSED pouches naturally leaning in a shallow retail shelf tray, front pouch fully visible. Generic grocery shelf background gently out of focus; no competitor brands, no shelf prices, no identifiable real store. This is a conceptual retail visualization, not evidence of a store visit. Add tasteful small headings above panels "Объёмная визуализация" and "На полке". Footer "AI-визуализация · ImageGen". No arrows or technical diagram. The first reference's artwork must wrap naturally around film but remain legible. Do not invent ingredient text or certification. Keep artwork materially the same as reference1, do not replace with additional ornate mountains from reference2. All images crisp photorealistic premium studio quality.
